name: Oc vu nang
summary: A spire-shaped snail found beside steep sea cliffs, gray-black and knobby outside and smooth pink, white, or cream inside. Boiled or grilled, it has a natural sweet taste.
taste: A natural sweet taste when boiled or grilled.
howToEat: Have it boiled or grilled. It also comes sautéed, in salad, steamed in a little water, with salt, pepper, and lemon, or grilled with onion fat.
where: Seaside restaurants and the fishing village.
seoTitle: Oc vu nang — spire snail in Con Dao
seoDescription: Ốc vú nàng is the Côn Đảo cliff snail, boiled or grilled for a natural sweet taste.
